name: King's College London
summary: A large central London university known for health, law and its Department of War Studies; IB offers let you meet either a points total or an HL score.

ib.text: Offers give a total including ToK/EE or an aggregate of three HL grades, from 32 or HL 15 up to 40 or HL 21; AAA courses ask 36 or HL 18. English A at HL 4 or SL 5 meets the English requirement.

notes: Without UK settled or pre-settled status you pay the international fee, for example £35,900 a year for International Relations BA in 2027-28.
International applicants pay a £2,000 deposit against the first year's fee when they firmly accept an unconditional offer.
The IB rule is either/or: you can meet an offer with the points total or with the HL aggregate, though any named subject grades still apply.
